leads.arxiv: 2508.13250 (arXiv API: v1 2025-08-18; title: Explicit v.s. Implicit Memory: Exploring Multi-hop Complex Reasoning Over Personalized Information)

community_list_entries.section: Resources / Benchmarks and Tasks / Personalized Task Evaluation
community_list_entries.name: MPR

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Paper builds a multi-hop personalized reasoning dataset plus a unified evaluation framework (released at nuster1128/MPR) comparing explicit (RAG over textual user statements) and implicit (LoRA fine-tuning) memory; HybridMem method is a secondary contribution.

phase1_verified_types.parametric: Sec. 1: 'Implicit memory refers to storing users' personalized information within model parameters'. Sec. 3.4.2/5.1: LoRA-based MaskSFT/AskSFT are run against explicit RAG memory, all scored by Exact Match on the same 2-10 hop QA.
